notes: Main-split ABox revision of a stored fact (15 queries), 2026-11-12, replacing the earlier "Manjaro is based on Ubuntu" (rated unlikely; based_on has no near-question property: not functional, not symmetric, and its inverse is untagged). Chosen for transitivity and subproperty, which the topic otherwise only has on the derived edits: direct_subsidiary_of (RELATIONS.md, finance) is functional and a subproperty of the transitive subsidiary_of. Related near is functional; related far reaches npm through GitHub (transitivity: Dolma has few exact hits, so the claim rests on the two Wikipedia sentences that state npm's owner and GitHub's). Derived: subproperty (same owner as Beats), composition (the parent's state), binding (the Octocat). The indeterminate query is the classic background-beliefs split: Copilot's owner stored by name or as GitHub's parent. Apple was chosen as the new owner because Microsoft sits in Washington and Apple in California, so the state question changes. The paired contraction (technology-delete-0014) still removes "Manjaro is based on Arch Linux" and needs repairing by whoever owns the delete records. Counts are exact-phrase counts in Dolma (v4_dolma-v1_7_llama) except those marked approximate.
